title: CertVLA: Certified Defense against Physical Visual Attacks for Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.20791v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are vulnerable to localized physical perturbations, yet existing certified patch defenses target discrete labels and cannot directly certify continuous, temporally correlated actions. We introduce CertVLA, a certified defense for closed-loop VLA control under bounded patch and texture attacks. CertVLA proposes a calibrated region of behaviorally consistent actions, while deterministic covering masks ensure that at least one checked prediction is attack-free. Specifically, CertVLA normalizes action disagreement by the benign variation of each mask pair and accepts a single-mask anchor only when it remains consistent under every second mask. It then calibrates the resulting max-min-max episode score to provide finite-sample clean coverage. translated_title: CertVLA：针对视觉-语言-动作模型的物理视觉攻击的认证防御
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略易受局部物理扰动的影响，然而现有的认证补丁防御针对离散标签，无法直接认证连续的、时间相关的动作。我们提出了CertVLA，一种用于闭环VLA控制在有界补丁和纹理攻击下的认证防御方法。CertVLA提出了一种校准的行为一致动作区域，同时确定性覆盖掩码确保至少有一个被检查的预测是无攻击的。具体来说，CertVLA通过每个掩码对的良性变化来规范化动作分歧，并且仅当单一掩码锚点在所有第二掩码下保持一致时才接受它。然后，它校准得到的最大-最小-最大情节分数，以提供有限样本的清洁覆盖。结合查询级决策将动作证书扩展到完整的闭环滚动过程。此外，我们证明了对任何满足条件的自适应攻击者，该方法都能提供保证。
tldr: CertVLA首次为视觉-语言-动作模型提供闭环控制下的物理补丁和纹理攻击认证防御，通过校准行为一致性和覆盖掩码，确保至少一个预测无攻击并扩展到完整滚动过程。
en_tdlr: CertVLA is the first certified defense for closed-loop vision-language-action control against bounded physical patch and texture attacks, ensuring at least one attack-free prediction via calibrated behavioral consistency and covering masks, with certificates extended to full rollouts.
